posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Some of you may know that I actually Kickstarted my own game--Cold Steel Wardens: Roleplaying in the Iron Age of Comics--at the end of 2012.  

Well, after numerous delays in art and layout, followed by more delays on my publisher's end, CSW is finally up for sale!  I'm so excited!  I'm a published game designer!  :D

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
I’m so excited! I’ve been working CSW for nearly 4 years now, between writing, playtesting, development, and draft production, so to see it actually released is a huge point.

Plus, I’m at Origins right now, about to run demos of it!
